reason: Admin pages are behind require_super_admin and count or list memberships for the admin tables; there is no per-agent access decision to make.
Admin pages are behind require_super_admin (super admins see every ticket): team ticket counts, the category review queue and ticket lookups for the outbound mail table.
My tickets in the portal is the requester's own tickets (requester_email equals the signed-in user); agent access rules do not apply to it.
own_first_message reads only the requester's PUBLIC inbound message, to quote the original in outbound mail; it never returns notes.
Agent search matches message bodies inside a condition that visibility.visible_ticket_condition already narrowed; the requester never sees search.
The agent team activity feed lists messages (including notes) of tickets the agent can open, filtered by visible_ticket_condition; the requester never sees it.
